title: Row presence avatar is suppressed for the current user; feed rows are separate
answers: Why doesn't my own avatar show on task or canvas rows in Spaces?
Where is presence avatar hidden for the current user?
Own face shown with 'You are working on this' on a channel row
body:
Presence on task/canvas rows means "who else is here", so the current user's own avatar must never render.
- Enforced in products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/canvas/components/ChannelItemPresence.tsx:RowPresence, which returns null when `currentUserUuid && author.user.uuid === currentUserUuid`, before the idle-tier check.
- ActiveRowPresence only builds labels for others: "<label> is working on this" (live) and "<label> was here recently". No "You ..." labels exist any more.
- Do not reintroduce own-user labels or avatars in ChannelItemRow.
- Feed rows in ChannelFeedView show the author avatar even when idle and are intentionally a separate path, not covered by this rule.
applies: Spaces ChannelItemRow presence (task and canvas rows) in products/desktop/packages/ui
